entry.name: launchers
entry.label: Pinned apps (launcher URLs), in dock order. The look-and-feel layout writes the same list at first login.

entry.name: magnify
entry.label: Magnify icons under the pointer (hovered 1.6x, neighbours 1.3x / 1.1x at Normal). One switch shared with the top bar's quick settings, kept in sync both ways.

entry.name: magnification
entry.label: subtle (1.3x), normal (1.6x) or strong (1.9x) for the hovered icon.

entry.name: groupApps
entry.label: One icon per application; clicking a group cycles through its windows.

entry.name: showOnlyCurrentDesktop
entry.label: Only show windows from the current virtual desktop.

entry.name: showOnlyCurrentActivity
entry.label: Only show windows from the current activity. Off by default (v4): a window on another activity would otherwise leave its pinned icon looking closed; with either filter on, the dock still marks such an app as running and a click brings that window back instead of starting a second copy.

entry.name: maxIconSize
entry.label: Upper bound for the resting icon size in pixels.

entry.name: showStart
entry.label: Fab OS start button as the first dock item (opens the launcher menu through plasmashell's activateLauncherMenu; the stock launcher applet sits zero-width beside the dock as the menu's owner). Same size and magnify as every other icon.

entry.name: showPeek
entry.label: "Peek at the desktop" as the last dock item (KWin's Show Desktop). Same size and magnify as every other icon.

entry.name: tileScale
entry.label: Fab OS app icons are full-bleed rounded tiles while Breeze app icons leave a margin inside their box; tiles (Fab OS app icons, the start button's launcher tile and peek's neutral tile) are drawn at this fraction of the box so every item's visible extent equals a Breeze app icon's glyph (measured by tests/dock-qml-harness/measure.py from the harness renders).
